title: Structure over Pixels: Learning Variable-Length Visual Programs
abstract: arXiv:2605.27696v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Discrete visual tokenizers map images to ordered sequences of tokens, providing a natural representation for structural scene descriptions. Most use a fixed sequence length, while adaptive methods often require post-hoc search or choose among a small set of rates that control the length. We propose STROP, a discrete tokenizer that learns both a visual program and its image-dependent active length. A length head is trained with a four-phase curriculum using local rate-distortion probes against frozen DINOv3 features, then predicts the active prefix in a single forward pass. At a matched rate of about $250$ nominal bits per crop, the adaptive model improves segmentation over a separately trained fixed-length baseline on four benchmarks (by $1.6$-$3.1$ mIoU), and it also beats a fixed $K{=}32$ baseline that uses more bits. STROP programs also yield higher segmentation mIoU than FlexTok, One-D-Piece, and ALIT at similar or higher r

translated_title: 结构优先于像素：学习可变长度的视觉程序
translated_abstract: 离散视觉分词器将图像映射为有序的 token 序列，为结构化场景描述提供了自然的表示方式。大多数方法使用固定的序列长度，而自适应方法通常需要事后搜索，或只能在一组控制长度的小速率集合中进行选择。我们提出 STROP，一种离散分词器，它同时学习视觉程序及其依赖图像的有效长度。该长度头通过四阶段课程进行训练，利用针对冻结 DINOv3 特征的局部率失真探测，然后在单次前向传播中预测有效前缀。在每张裁剪图约 250 标称比特的匹配速率下，该自适应模型在四个基准上相比单独训练的固定长度基线提升了分割性能（提升 1.6–3.1 mIoU），并且优于使用更多比特的固定 K=32 基线。在相似或更高的速率下，STROP 程序的分割 mIoU 也高于 FlexTok、One-D-Piece 和 ALIT。
tldr: STROP 是一种能同时学习视觉程序和图像自适应有效长度的离散视觉分词器，在约 250 比特每图的速率下，分割性能超越固定长度基线以及 FlexTok 等现有方法。
en_tdlr: STROP is a discrete visual tokenizer that jointly learns a visual program and its image-dependent active length, improving segmentation over fixed-length baselines and outperforming FlexTok, One-D-Piece, and ALIT at similar or higher rates.
